blockers: Faction-funded build: treasury pays 1000 labor + 723 royalty; materials drawn from faction storage. Set fund_from_faction=true.
message: Faction shipyard quote for Congregation. Build it faction-funded (commission_ship fund_from_faction=true, requires ManageTreasury): materials come from faction storage and the treasury pays 1000 labor + 723 royalty. The credits-only and provide_materials modes do not apply here.
